requiredFindings.title: Include the fault cause in the detailed-failure rendering rule
requiredFindings.finding: R2 fixes termination rendering for kind:doctor and correctly requires complete outcome parity, including refused outcomes. Its separate kind:failure rendering rule at line 62 still lists Termination, Error, Detail/Subject/Remedy and Request without Fault cause. Busy, host-I/O and budget refusals are kind:failure and carry ledger-busy, host-io and host-invariant respectively. Following that concrete layout drops a termination fact that line 65 now requires human output to preserve.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Add Fault cause when present to the detailed-failure rule, or explicitly share the complete termination renderer specified for doctor reports. Keep the errors detail blocks, subjects and remedies, and do not invent a fault cause on request-rejected envelopes.
requiredFindings.validation: Compare human and JSON termination facts for busy, host-I/O and budget refusals, as well as request-rejected refusals and the now-correct doctor report branches.

requiredFindings.title: Finish assigning test vectors to their layers and remove the retired run_with deliverable
requiredFindings.finding: The layered crate arrangement resolves the original visibility/cfg(test) problem. Two remnants make its coverage description inconsistent: security is assigned one other defect even though DoctorInstallation can carry only Complete or Incomplete structural findings, and X10a still explicitly delivers the run_with test seam that item 5 replaces. Also, a Complete observation with the production other=[] argument cannot generate the mixed-complete or 255+note/256 vectors; those require explicitly synthetic host assembler inputs, not the security producer output alone.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Limit security coverage to real complete/incomplete observations and refusals. Move mixed-complete and complete-report capacity vectors to explicitly synthetic host tests supplying other DomainDetail entries through the existing assembler/doctor_installation interface, while retaining other=[] in the production ingress. If one other defect instead means one structural finding, say so and expect Incomplete without the note. Replace the X10a run_with bullet with the agreed layered tests/projection work; no producer-injection seam or cross-crate bridge is needed.
requiredFindings.validation: The law should distinguish native observation coverage from synthetic host report-bound coverage, retain both complete and partial bounds, and name no retired run_with producer seam as a deliverable. The resulting layers fit the existing crate APIs and ordinary dependency configuration.
